PILOT_1.description: Initial four-call pilot, one call per language profile (approved by the user, spending ceiling USD 2.00).

PILOT_2.description: Expanded pilot: 16 additional calls (four per language profile) chosen from the frozen specs for coverage; OpenAI standard (sync) API for G3, G4 and G6; G5 and G7 by Claude-assisted review (no provider). Spending ceiling USD 3.00 (expected about 1.3).

PILOT_2_G6V5.description: G6 prompt v5 regeneration of the 16 PILOT_2 calls in place through --reopen (OpenAI standard sync API, one candidate attempt per call, run sequentially; each candidate gets a Claude-assisted G7 review before the next call; no provider G7). Approved by the user 2026-10-27, additional provider spending ceiling USD 5.00 (expected well under 1.0).
